description: One call over the live GSC query×page matrix: queries where two or more qualifying pages (at least 2 impressions, at least 10% of the query's impressions, position 30 or better) compete, ordered by clicks landing on non-leader pages. Each group carries the leader's impression share and each page's position and clicks, winner first — evidence for fold/canonical decisions, not a deletion verdict. Live GSC read on paid plans, daily-capped. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_gsc_cannibalization
title: Queries split across competing pages
